question: Estimate the addressable market size for organic / clean-label food products in urban India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Organic + clean-label (no preservatives, natural) packaged food? Yes.
Includes fresh produce certified organic? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Affluent urban × organic-buying penetration × annual spend.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, health-conscious / aware of organic: ~40% = ~13M HH.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, health-conscious / aware of organic
Of these, regular organic buyers (any frequency)
Average annual organic spend per buying HH

calculationFlow: Top 30% income tier (₹10L+ HH income): ~33M HH.
Of these, health-conscious / aware of organic: ~40% = ~13M HH.
Of these, regular organic buyers (any frequency): ~30% = ~4M HH.
Average annual organic spend per buying HH: ~₹15,000.
Plus institutional/HoReCa organic (cafes, premium restaurants): ~₹1,500 Cr.
